title: zesty pan-seared australian dried shrimp hash
description: a cultured and tender solo dinner dish featuring the flavors of australian dried shrimp, perfect for a weeknight meal. this recipe is anti-inflammatory friendly and prepared using a tava griddle.
instructions: heat the tava griddle to medium-high heat, about 200°C.
add the shio-cured pork belly and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until crispy.
set aside the cooked pork belly on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
in the same tava griddle, add the ghee and cook the brown onion for 4-5 minutes, or until softened.
add the australian dried shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly browned.
add the korean chili flakes and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
return the cooked pork belly to the tava griddle and stir to combine with the shrimp mixture.
season with salt, black pepper, and coconut aminos to taste.
transfer the mixture to a serving plate or individual plates and garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and scallions if using.
squeeze the fresh lime juice over the dish just before serving, if desired.
